method.scope: Descriptive same final routing AR weights; eval/no_grad, no optimizer/update, fitting or gate
method.original_four: All192 original patches/five strata/regions retained with original pure aggregation and comparison math
method.fifth: For each case slots0..7 donor=(slot+4)%8; donor FP64 ownA1 mean rounded to FP32 and broadcast on recipient ownA1
method.estimand: Own block scalar mean correspondence versus a fixed between-block scalar reassignment. Eight block scalar means preserved per case; site-weighted radius multiset NOT preserved. This differs from pointwise own-A half-ring spatial association.
method.support: All eight donor and recipient blocks require positive measured support; record FP32 scalar differences AND actual consumed zR differences. Support/variation is not a new efficacy gate.
method.aggregation: Original patch equal within case, case equal across cases; fine sum covered/sum nodes within each case. Sources each retain four cases.
method.uniform: Fifth-field uniform96 patches NOT EVALUATED; no invented zeros, full-all16 fifth aggregate, or support extrapolation
method.regional: TP/FP/FN patch mean per case, then case equal; BCE sum/real voxels within case then case equal. Real observed six-face distance bins; no regional skeleton/Dice/anatomical wall interpretation.
method.limitations: Oracle A is geometry-dependent support, not anatomical background; mean controls are not retrained A_only; nonlinear effects are not additive information decomposition. Same12 TRAIN cases/overlapping patches, no patient/zero-shot independence.
method.precision: Original count/derived metrics parity exact; nonnegative BCE allows2 binary64 ULP. No old voxelwise mask parity claim; regional BCE closure1e-12 FP64 tolerance.
